## Language

{{< include /components/_lang.qmd >}}

```{ojs}
import {
  loadNotebookContent,
  notebookTitle,
} from "/helpers/notebook.js";

notebookContent = await loadNotebookContent(notebookConfig)

nbTextAll = notebookContent.text

sectionsAll = notebookContent.sections

nbText = nbTextAll[language.key] ?? nbTextAll.en

sections = sectionsAll[language.key] ?? sectionsAll.en

nbTitle = notebookTitle(notebookConfig, language.key)

nbMethods = sections.methods?.title

contributors = FileAttachment("/data/shared/contributors.json").json()

tmpl = (template, values) =>
  Lang.reduceReplaceTemplateItems(
    template,
    Object.entries(values).map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value })),
  )
```

```{ojs}
{
  Lang.applyTranslations({
    sections,
    md,
    lang: language.key,
    headings: {
      ...(nbText.headings ?? {}),
      contributions: _lang(general_translations.contributors),
      appendix: _lang(general_translations.appendix),
    },
  });
}
```
